claims.summary: The canonical 128-case B/A task is emitted as eight immutable 16-case review templates and eight matching decisions skeletons, replacing one operationally fragile 543,277-byte review and 123,877-byte decision pair with bounded units.

Original review indices are assigned modulo eight to interleave domains, while the tracked receipt binds each payload, index list, pair set, canonical full-template hash, and exact reconstruction order.

All chunks remain one B/A reading: completion requires one exact Codex revision, runtime, fresh session, timestamp, prior-outcome statement, context-reset attestation, and judgment attestation across every file.

The assembler validates each chunk, restores canonical 128-case order in memory, runs the full structural validator, zeroes assembled completed-pass bytes, and exclusively emits one AES-256-GCM envelope plus one 0600 key without writing a combined pass.

The workbook is ready but the real B/A judgment, stable preferences, approved rows, learned weights, held-out wins, device evidence, and paid-reference parity remain zero; public Scion stays base-only.
